# Eden by Zenterra

> Presale 1, 2 & 3 bedroom condominiums at 19936 77 Avenue, Willoughby, Langley, BC, built by Zenterra Developments. Estimated completion Summer to Fall 2028.

- Website: https://www.edenbyzenterra.ca/
- Presentation centre: 190 Willoughby Town Centre Drive, Langley, BC (Open 12 – 5 PM daily, closed Fridays)
- Phone: 778.762.1902
- Email: eden@zenterra.ca
